summary: Isolated & Dual-Mode Thermal Receipt Printing Architecture: Clean receipt printing using dynamic hidden iframe isolation, direct Web Bluetooth ESC/POS engine, silent auto-reconnect via navigator.bluetooth.getDevices() (zero-prompt post-payment printing), effective roll width compensation (48mm for 58mm roll, 72mm for 80mm roll), Universal Normal Weight (Zero-Bold / Anti-Bleed) standard, WYSIWYG live preview alignment, Floyd-Steinberg monochrome logo dithering & ESC/POS GS v 0 raster encoding, and structured Item & Order Notes thermal formatting.
